title: Red and Yellow Make Orange!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: What happens when red paint and yellow paint swirl together? Let's mix them and see!
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
One red drop, plus one yellow drop. Swirl, swirl, swirl... it's orange! Red and yellow make orange.
This is my friend Orange! Orange is a warm, bright, happy color. Can you say orange? Orange is a happy color.
An orange is orange. A crunchy carrot is orange. A big round pumpkin is orange, too!
Can you find something orange near you? Point to it! Red and yellow make orange. See you in the lab!

title: Let's Count Seven Little Ducks!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: Quack, quack! Some little ducks waddled into my lab. How many ducks are there?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
Let's count them together. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven! Seven little ducks.
This is the number seven. Seven comes right after six. Can you say seven? Ducks love to splash and paddle in the pond.
Look at my counting frame. Five dots on the top, and two more on the bottom. That makes seven!
Can you hold up seven fingers? Five on one hand, and two more! Quack, quack! See you in the lab!

title: A Cube Has Six Square Sides!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: Gift boxes and toy blocks can have the very same shape. Do you know what it's called?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
It's a cube! Look at this side. It's a square. Every side of a cube is a square.
A cube has six flat sides. Flat sides help cubes stack up tall without rolling away. Count with me: one, two, three, four, five, six!
A gift box can be a cube. A little toy block is a cube, too!
Can you find something shaped like a cube at home? Cube! Can you say it? See you in the lab!

title: Big and Small: Fun Opposites!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: One jelly friend is super big, and one jelly friend is super small. Can you spot them?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
This purple friend is big! Big body, and a big shiny star. Big, big, big!
Big and small are opposites. Opposites are as different as can be. One is big, and one is small.
This yellow friend is small. Small body, and a small little star. Small, small, small!
Can you stretch up big and tall? Now curl up small, like a little ball! Big and small. See you in the lab!

title: Red and Blue Make Purple!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: Red and blue are best friends. What new color do they make when they mix?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
One red drop, plus one blue drop. Swirl, swirl, swirl... it's purple! Red and blue make purple.
This is my friend Purple! Purple is the color of grapes and pretty flowers. Can you say purple? Purple is so pretty.
Grapes can be purple. An eggplant is purple. This little flower is purple, too!
Can you find something purple near you? Point to it! Red and blue make purple. See you in the lab!

title: Count to Ten With Bloop!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: Wiggle your fingers! How many fingers do you have? Let's count all the way to ten!
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
Count my jelly friends with me. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
Ten! Ten is a big number. Ten comes right after nine. Can you say ten? One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
Look at my counting frame. Five dots on top, and five on the bottom. Every box is full!
You have ten fingers and ten toes. Wiggle them all! Ten, ten, ten! See you in the lab!

title: Rainbow Colors in Order!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: A rainbow always has its colors in the very same order. Can you name them with me?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple! Red is always on the top of the rainbow.
Rainbows can appear when the sun shines while it rains. Sunshine, plus raindrops, makes a rainbow! The sun needs to be behind you to see it.
Twinkle, twinkle! A rainbow is a big, bright, beautiful arch high in the sky.
Let's say the order one more time. Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple! See you in the lab!

title: A Sphere Is Round Like a Ball!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: This shape is round all the way around, and it loves to roll. What shape is it?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
It's a sphere! A sphere is round everywhere, with no corners and no flat sides at all.
Give a sphere a little push, and it rolls, and rolls, and rolls! Round and round it goes, and it never gets stuck on a corner.
A beach ball is a sphere. A juicy orange is a sphere, too!
Can you roll your arms round and round like a rolling ball? Sphere! Can you say it? See you in the lab!

title: What Comes Next? Color Pattern Fun!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: Red, blue, red, blue, red... Can you guess which color comes next?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
Blue! Red, blue, red, blue, red, blue. The two colors take turns, again and again.
When something repeats like that, we call it a pattern. Can you say pattern? A pattern goes the same way, over and over, like a song we sing again and again.
Look up high! Yellow, green, yellow, green, yellow, green. That's another pattern!
Can you make a pattern with your body? Clap, stomp, clap, stomp, clap, stomp! See you in the lab!

title: Up and Down: Fun Opposites!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: A balloon floats way up high, and a ball rolls down low. Which way is up?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
Up! The red balloon floats up, up, up, toward the sky.
Up and down are opposites. Up is high, near the sky. Down is low, near the floor. Up, up, up! Down, down, down!
Down! When you drop a ball, it falls down, down, down, all the way to the floor.
Reach your hands up high! Now put your hands down low! Up and down, up and down. See you in the lab!

title: Can You Spot Green Things?
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: Grab your magnifying glass! Today we're going on a hunt for things that are green.
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
I spy a green leaf, and a little green frog. Ribbit, ribbit!
Green is the color of grass and trees. There is lots of green outside! Green leaves, green grass, green bushes and tall green trees. Let's keep hunting!
More green things! A crunchy green apple, and a wiggly green caterpillar.
Can you find something green near you? Point to it! Green, green, green! See you in the lab!

title: Pointy Top, Round Bottom: A Cone!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: This shape has a pointy top and a round bottom. Do you know its name?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
It's a cone! The bottom is a circle, and the top comes to a point.
Lay a cone on its side and give it a push. It rolls around in a circle! Round and round!
An ice cream cone is a cone. An orange traffic cone is a cone, too!
Can you make a pointy cone hat with your hands on your head? Cone! Can you say it? See you in the lab!

title: Light Blue and Dark Blue!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: Did you know blue can be light, and blue can be dark? Let's take a look!
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
Look at my blue colors. They start light and pale, and get darker, and darker, and darker!
Mix a little white paint into blue, and it gets lighter. Mix in black, and it gets darker. Light, lighter, dark, darker!
The sky in the daytime is light blue. The sky at night is dark blue!
Can you say light blue? Now say dark blue! Great job, color friend. See you in the lab!

title: Let's Sort by Color With Bloop!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: My red things and blue things got all mixed up. Can you help me sort them?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
Red things go in the red basket. A red apple, a red heart, and a red ball!
Sorting means putting things that are the same together. Same color, same basket! Let's sort by color!
Blue things go in the blue basket. A blue ball, a blue star, and a blue fish!
Red with red, blue with blue. We sorted them all! Thank you for helping. See you in the lab!

title: Small, Medium and Big!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: Three jelly friends, in three different sizes. Can you find the biggest one?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
Small, medium, big! Look at their stars. A small star, a medium star, and a big star.
The big friend is the biggest. The small friend is the smallest. Medium is in the middle! Small, medium, big. Can you say it?
Party hats! A small hat, a medium hat, and a big hat. Every hat fits just right.
Can you make yourself small, then medium, then big, big, big? See you in the lab!

title: A Cylinder Has Two Circles!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: It looks like a can, with a circle on each end. What shape is it?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
It's a cylinder! There's a circle on the top, and a circle on the bottom.
A cylinder can stand up tall, or lie down on its side and roll. Stand it up, or lay it down. Roll, roll, roll! A cylinder is easy to roll.
A toy drum is a cylinder. A cup can be a cylinder, too!
Can you roll like a cylinder? Roll, roll, roll! Cylinder! Can you say it? See you in the lab!
